note: Grenada: a foreign entertainer works on a work permit under the Foreign Nationals and Commonwealth Citizens (Employment) Regulations, whose fee for entertainers from The Bahamas, Barbados, Belize, Guyana, Jamaica, Montserrat, Suriname, Trinidad and Tobago and Cuba is $2,500 for a band and $500 for an individual (S.R.O. 26 of 2015). No days of work without it are named. OECS citizens work freely (the oecs list, first); other CARICOM artistes and musicians of the participating states on the Skills Certificate (the csme list).
